corrections.why: The 2015 MDC area plan describes the towers as Department towers, with Department staff inspecting them; the older Central US Lookouts listing uses the Commission's name.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Central US Lookouts page names the Missouri Conservation Commission; the 2015 MDC plan names the Missouri Department of Conservation. The Department is used, and the older name is noted in the story.

sources.title: 2015 Texas County Towersites Area Management Plan

notes_for_editor: Built year (1960) agrees across both sources. Current status and public access are unverified: the 2015 plan has no access statement for the Houston site (its Cabool appendix says that tower is closed to the public, which is not this tower). OpenStreetMap node 12729567032 tags access=yes and fee=no; that is a volunteer tag, not an authority statement, so no access key was set. The Facebook posts by Missouri Conservation History and Equipment mention an Aermotor MC-39 design and directions, but the fetch returned no readable text, so they are not cited. A 2018 local news item in the Central US Lookouts page concerns a private individual and is left out.
